column1: I'm truly sorry, sir. Is there anything I can do to convince you to let me off? And, I DO mean anything!
column2: 「真的很抱歉，先生。我能做些什麼說服你放我一馬嗎？而且，我是認真的！」

column1: Why, I've never heard of anyone by that name, Officer!
column2: 「警官，我從沒聽過那個名字！」

column1: Why, Officer! she smiles coyly. "Please don't stare there!!"
column2: 「哎呀，警官！」她羞怯地笑著。「請別盯著那裡看！」

column1: Why don't you look at my license? she asks.
column2: 「你為什麼不看看我的駕照？」她問。

column1: Good day, Ma'am, you say, trying to keep your glance high. "I'm Officer Sonny Bonds."
column2: 你努力把視線抬高，說：「午安，女士。我是 Sonny Bonds 警員。」

column1: Your heart slips up into your throat! %m5
column2: 你的心臟一下子跳到喉嚨口！%m5

column1: Short memory, Officer? she snickers.
column2: 「警官，你記性真差？」她竊笑道。

column1: What did I do wrong, Officer? she says, showing her best smile.
column2: 「警官，我做錯了什麼？」她露出最燦爛的笑容。

column1: That is unnecessary for a simple traffic violation.
column2: 普通交通違規不需要那樣做。

column1: Nice try, but unfortunately, unnecessary in a traffic violation.
column2: 想得不錯，但很遺憾，交通違規不需要那樣做。

column1: R. J. Jefferson, the Department's janitor, does good work. Don't mess it up!
column2: 警局清潔工 R. J. Jefferson 做得很不錯。別把它弄亂！

column1: You see a textured ceiling with florescent lighting.
column2: 你看見有紋理的天花板和螢光燈。

column1: You don't need anything in the drawer.
column2: 抽屜裡沒有你需要的東西。

column1: Under the table, 243 pieces of gum defy gravity.
column2: 桌子底下有 243 塊口香糖違反重力黏著。

column1: The wooden bench is securely attached to the floor.
column2: 木頭長椅牢牢固定在地板上。

column1: You can't move something that's anchored to the floor.
column2: 固定在地板上的東西動不了。

column1: The spigot is out of reach.
column2: 水龍頭搆不到。

column1: There's no doubt that somewhere in your life you fell off a high porch and landed hard on your head!
column2: 毫無疑問，你人生某個時候一定從高高的門廊摔下來，還重重撞到了頭！

column1: Grown policemen don't climb on benches, Sonny.
column2: 成年警察不會爬長椅，Sonny。

column1: This shower is already occupied. (And you're not that kind of boy!)
column2: 這間淋浴間已經有人了。（而且你不是那種男孩！）

column1: Morris Fudley has worn out this shower!
column2: Morris Fudley 把這間淋浴間用壞了！

column1: You look down and note a very clean, blue-tiled floor.
column2: 你低頭看見非常乾淨的藍色磁磚地板。

column1: We lock it up, not give it out.
column2: 「我們把它鎖起來，不是拿出去。」

column1: Hi, Sonny, says Russ. "What do you need?"
column2: Russ 說：「嗨，Sonny。你需要什麼？」

column1: Now, Sonny, you know this is official evidence. Don't go running off with it!
column2: 「Sonny，你知道這是正式證物。別拿著它跑掉！」

column1: You see Russ looking back at you.
column2: 你看見 Russ 回頭望著你。

column1: Move outta the way!
column2: 「讓開！」

column1: Another day, another dollar! Write some tickets and Dooley won't holler!
column2: 「過一天賺一天！多開幾張罰單，Dooley 就不會吼叫！」

column1: Detective Bonds, it appears you've been on a roll lately!
column2: 「Bonds 警探，看來你最近表現得很順利！」

column1: You lost those keys, remember?
column2: 你把那些鑰匙弄丟了，記得嗎？

column1: Since you're not assigned to this vehicle, there's no need to safety check it.
column2: 你不是這輛車的編派警員，不需要檢查它的安全性。

column1: The back seat is reserved for prisoners and you have none!
column2: 後座是給犯人坐的，而你現在沒有犯人！

column1: Trying to crawl through the window? %m2
column2: 想從窗戶爬進去嗎？%m2

column1: You don't have the keys to this car.
column2: 你沒有這輛車的鑰匙。

column1: There is no reason to open the passengers' doors.
column2: 沒有理由打開乘客側的車門。

column1: Laura says, "Sonny, I'll go write up this arrest."
column2: Laura 說：「Sonny，我去寫這份逮捕報告。」

column1: As you start to examine the evidence, you hear Jack's voice behind you, "Just leave that stuff in the trunk, Sonny. I'll impound it along with the car."
column2: 你開始檢查證物時，聽見 Jack 在身後說：「那些東西就留在後車廂，Sonny。我會連同車子一起扣押。」
